policy_name: 21 CFR § 870.2785 ("Software for optical camera-based measurement of pulse rate, heart rate, breathing rate, and/or respiratory rate")
question: Given the special controls for Class II devices under § 870.2785, what specific criteria will be used to evaluate the comprehensive hazard analysis and risk assessment to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the software's vital sign measurements?
answer_low_temp:
The comprehensive hazard analysis and risk assessment for the software under § 870.2785 will be evaluated based on the following specific criteria:

1. A full characterization of the software technical parameters, including algorithms (1(i)).
2. If required image acquisition hardware is not included with the device, full specifications of the hardware requirements and testing to demonstrate the specified hardware ensures adequate data for validated and accurate measurements (1(ii)).
3. A description of the expected impact of all applicable sensor acquisition hardware characteristics and associated hardware specifications (1(iii)).
4. A description of all mitigations for user error or failure of any subsystem components (including signal detection, signal analysis, data display, and storage) on output accuracy (1(iv)).
5. Software documentation must include a cybersecurity vulnerability and management process to assure software functionality (1(v)).
